name: Kenai
seo_title: Kenai Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 4 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kenai, Soldotna and Homer, Alaska for 2026: 5 family events, 4 free, with dates and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Kenai kicks off Christmas the day after Thanksgiving with Santa, an Electric Lights Parade and fireworks, and the Soldotna and Homer tree lightings and holiday concerts follow in December.
celebrates: The Kenai Chamber of Commerce and Visitor Center starts the season with Christmas Comes to Kenai on November 27, with Santa at the Visitors Center from 11 am to 4 pm, the Electric Lights Parade at 6 pm and fireworks at 7 pm. The Homer Chamber lights its tree on December 3 with Santa, the KP Brass Band and the Homer High School choir, and the Soldotna Chamber lights its tree at an open house on December 4. A community choir concert in Soldotna on December 11 and The Nutcracker in Homer on December 5 to 12 round out the Kenai Peninsula season.
lastyear: Christmas Comes to Kenai ran on Friday, November 28, 2025, with Santa at the Visitors Center from 11 am to 4 pm, the Electric Lights Parade at 6 pm and a fireworks show at 7 pm, according to a Peninsula Clarion story and the KSRM radio announcement. The Clarion reported that the parade began at Spur View Road along Frontage Road. The 2026 chamber listing keeps the same Santa hours, parade time and fireworks time, one day earlier in the holiday weekend.
facts: Kenai sits on the Kenai Spur Highway at the mouth of the Kenai River, and the chamber's Visitors Center at 11471 Kenai Spur Highway is the base for Santa on November 27. Soldotna's visitor center is on the Sterling Highway, and Homer's chamber is at 201 Sterling Highway, so the Sterling Highway links two of the three tree lightings on this page. Daylight is short in December, which is why most Kenai Peninsula events start in the afternoon or early evening.
trains: We did not find a train ride on the Kenai Peninsula. The Alaska Railroad's southern route reaches Seward in summer, and the Seward Depot, built in 1917, is the nearest rail site. It survived the 1964 earthquake, and Alaska Railroad holiday trains are listed on the railroad's own event page. See our Seward page for Christmas events there.
train_links: The 1917 depot at the ocean end of the Alaska Railroad, listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
traditions: Santa at the Visitors Center, an Electric Lights Parade and fireworks on the day after Thanksgiving.
The chamber's evening parade through Kenai, followed by fireworks at 7 pm.
The Homer Chamber lights its tree with Santa, the KP Brass Band, the Homer High School choir, crafts and hot cocoa.
Soldotna tree lighting and open house
The Soldotna Chamber's open house ends with the tree lit at 6 pm.
Singers from across the Kenai Peninsula gather for a free concert in Soldotna.
kidfact: Kenai's Electric Lights Parade is followed by fireworks at 7 pm, so children can see lights on the floats and then lights in the sky in one evening.
faq: The Kenai Chamber of Commerce holds Christmas Comes to Kenai on the day after Thanksgiving, with Santa at the Visitors Center, an Electric Lights Parade at 6 pm and fireworks at 7 pm. Soldotna and Homer light their trees in early December.
Is there a free Christmas event in Kenai?

Yes. The chamber's page does not print a price for Christmas Comes to Kenai, and we list it as free because the parade is a public street event. The Soldotna and Homer tree lightings and the community choir concert are listed as free by their hosts.
Where can kids meet Santa in Kenai?
Santa is at the Kenai Visitors Center from 11 am to 4 pm on November 27, and he arrives at the Homer tree lighting at 5:30 pm on December 3.
Is there a train ride on the Kenai Peninsula?
We did not find one. The nearest rail site is the Seward Depot. See our Seward page for events there.
Are there Christmas events in Soldotna and Homer?

Yes, and they are on this page: the Soldotna Chamber tree lighting on December 4, the Kenai Peninsula Community Christmas Choir Concert on December 11, the Homer tree lighting on December 3 and The Nutcracker in Homer on December 5 to 12.
sources: Kenai Chamber of Commerce and Visitor Center

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kenai for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Christmas Comes to Kenai) through December 12 (the last performance of The Nutcracker in Homer), with the Homer Holiday Tree Lighting (December 3), the Soldotna Chamber Holiday Tree Lighting (December 4) and the Kenai Peninsula Community Christmas Choir Concert (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kenai

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Kenai, Soldotna and Homer
  • 4 free events: Christmas Comes to Kenai, the Soldotna Chamber Holiday Tree Lighting, the Kenai Peninsula Community Christmas Choir Concert and the Homer Holiday Tree Lighting
  • Meet Santa: at the Kenai Visitors Center on November 27 and at the Homer tree lighting on December 3
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Kenai Electric Lights Parade (November 27), then tree lightings in Homer (December 3) and Soldotna (December 4)
  • Trains: none on the Kenai Peninsula; the nearest are in Seward (see the Seward page)
  • Season: November 27 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Kenai Peninsula Alaska families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seward, which covers the tree lighting and the Alaska SeaLife Center holiday party.
